meta.name: ss-reference
meta.description: Compile screenshots, URLs, Figma exports, or an existing UI into a project-local StyleSeed output grammar with evidence, tokens, confidence, anti-patterns, and a validation screen. Use when the user supplies a design reference that StyleSeed does not already model.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计稿编译为本地样式规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从设计稿提取并维护样式规范
copy.tagline_en: Compile design references into local style specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often extract and maintain style specs from design files

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的截图、网址、Figma 导出或现有界面，提取设计规则（如间距、颜色、字体、层级、动效），生成一份项目本地的 StyleSeed 语法文件，并验证效果。
howto.when: 当你提供一份 StyleSeed 尚未建模的设计参考（如截图、URL、Figma 导出或现有 UI）时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这张 App 截图，生成设计规则。
say.note: Claude 会提取截图中的设计特征并输出语法文件。

say.text: 把这个网页的设计风格编译成 StyleSeed 语法。
say.note: Claude 会抓取网页并分析其设计系统。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes screenshots, URLs, Figma exports, or existing UIs to extract design rules (spacing, color, typography, hierarchy, motion) and compiles a project-local StyleSeed grammar file, then validates it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a design reference (screenshot, URL, Figma export, or existing UI) that StyleSeed does not already model.

say_en.text: Analyze this app screenshot and generate design rules.
say_en.note: Claude extracts design features and outputs a grammar file.

say_en.text: Compile this webpage's design style into StyleSeed grammar.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the page and analyzes its design system.
